official_sources.supports: Slovakia applies MLI beyond the minimum standard and pair matching with the other jurisdiction is required.
MLI text, Slovak ratification and requirement that treaty modifications follow Slovak reservations and notifications.
Observed matched Articles 6, 7, 10, 13 and 17 and WHT effective date for the Austria relationship.
Observed matched Articles 3, 4 and 11 among other modifications for the Poland relationship.
Observed matched Articles 4, 8, 12, 13 and other MLI modifications for the Slovenia relationship.
Observed Article 8 365-day dividend holding rule and Article 14 for the Israel relationship.
Observed matched Articles 3, 4, 8, 11, 13 and 15 among other modifications for the South Africa relationship.
Observed matched Articles 8, 10, 12, 13 and 14 and pair-specific WHT effective date for the Spain relationship.
Observed matched Articles 12, 13 and related PE modifications for the Vietnam relationship.

3.title: Transparent Entities
3.review_effect: May change whether income is treated as income of a treaty resident and therefore whether treaty benefits are available.

4.title: Dual Resident Entities
4.review_effect: For a dual-resident non-individual, treaty residence may depend on competent-authority agreement; absent agreement treaty relief may be unavailable.

6.title: Purpose of a Covered Tax Agreement
6.review_effect: Preamble modification informs treaty interpretation but is not a standalone rate rule.

7.title: Prevention of Treaty Abuse
7.review_effect: PPT may deny an otherwise available treaty benefit.

8.title: Dividend Transfer Transactions
8.review_effect: Where matched, reduced dividend rates tied to ownership conditions may require the ownership condition to be satisfied throughout a 365-day period including the payment date.

10.title: Anti-abuse Rule for Permanent Establishments Situated in Third Jurisdictions
10.review_effect: Where matched, treaty benefits can be denied for low-taxed income attributed by the residence jurisdiction to a PE in a third jurisdiction, subject to the article conditions and exceptions.

12.title: Artificial Avoidance of Permanent Establishment Status through Commissionnaire Arrangements and Similar Strategies
12.review_effect: Can create a PE under a broader dependent-agent rule and therefore alter the PE-connection analysis used by the operative income article.

13.title: Artificial Avoidance of Permanent Establishment Status through the Specific Activity Exemptions
13.review_effect: Option A and/or anti-fragmentation matching can alter whether a PE exists and therefore the PE-connection analysis.

14.title: Splitting-up of Contracts
14.review_effect: Can aggregate connected contract periods for PE threshold purposes, potentially changing the PE-connection branch.

15.title: Definition of a Person Closely Related to an Enterprise
15.review_effect: Supports Articles 12-14 and can affect whether their PE anti-avoidance rules apply.

5.title: Application of Methods for Elimination of Double Taxation
5.review_effect: Relevant to residence-state double-tax relief, not normally the Slovak source WHT rate conclusion.

9.title: Capital Gains from Alienation of Shares or Interests of Entities Deriving their Value Principally from Immovable Property
9.review_effect: Capital-gains rule outside the current dividend, interest and royalty product scope.

11.title: Application of Tax Agreements to Restrict a Party's Right to Tax its Own Residents
11.review_effect: Saving-clause rule primarily preserves taxation of a state's own residents; retain as treaty context but do not treat it as a Slovak outbound nonresident WHT rate modifier without a specific scenario.

16.title: Mutual Agreement Procedure
16.review_effect: Procedural dispute-resolution rule, not a transaction-level WHT rate rule.

17.title: Corresponding Adjustments
17.review_effect: Transfer-pricing corresponding-adjustment rule, not a direct dividend/interest/royalty WHT rate modifier.

review_requirements: For each of the 46 MLI-listed relationships ingest the Slov-Lex bilateral MLI modification notice or equivalent authoritative pair evidence.
Record which MLI articles actually match for that pair; do not infer matching from Slovakia's position alone.
Record the WHT-specific entry-into-effect date from the pair notice.
For dividend scopes test Article 8 before concluding that a reduced ownership-based treaty rate applies.
For all three income scopes test Articles 3, 4, 7 and 10 where matched.
Where transaction facts may involve a Slovak PE, test matched Articles 12-15 before resolving the PE-connection branch.
A relationship with only Article 6 context and Article 7 PPT may remain STANDARD if all matching and dates are mechanically clean; a matched substantive WHT article requires specific human attention.
